ITEM 1 | Bowl of mixed greens, dark green to purple-red leafy pieces with ruffled edges and some wilted, glossy leaf stems, spread around the rim and under other items, roughly 16 cm across footprint covering about a third of bowl, moist and limp | 45
ITEM 2 | Small green broccoli florets, bright to dark green with tight bumpy tops and pale stems, about 1.5 to 3 cm each, scattered across the bowl, firm and slightly moist | 60
ITEM 3 | Cubes of pale off-white firm tofu, about 2 cm square, matte surface with slightly porous texture, some edges lightly golden, scattered over the greens and beans | 75
ITEM 4 | Dark red kidney beans, glossy and smooth oval shapes about 1.5 cm long, firm and plump, dispersed throughout the bowl, moist surface | 80
ITEM 5 | Small black beans or black grains, matte to slightly glossy, tiny oval pieces about 0.5 cm, densely scattered and mixed among the greens and other ingredients, firm and dry | 70
